title: Bay Area Bashers at SoCal United

events.evidence: White players raise sticks, referee points toward center; later scoreboard is 0–1.
Shot/crease sequence and white-player reaction, then center faceoff; later score 0–2.
Crease scramble and white-player celebration. The official clock places the goal at 01:45 remaining; the exact ball crossing is unresolved, so the source window is widened.
White attack at the right net, raised sticks and stoppage; official goal clock is 08:07 remaining. The initial 2083–2086 s candidate was a later stoppage and is rejected.
White players raise sticks and gather after a crease play; delayed scoreboard update to 0–5.
Dark attack following a faceoff, goalie goes down and dark players gather; later score 1–5.
Crease action partly blocked by referee, white players celebrate, center restart; 1–6 scoreboard visually confirmed at source 2930 and 2945 seconds.
